name: mjlab-atomic-runtime-manager-profiles
instr:
MjLab cannot switch named sets of active manager terms at runtime while preserving simulation continuity and its policy-facing interface. Add immutable profiles with deterministic outcomes for MjLab environments and RSL-RL integrations. Existing integrations remain all-enabled by default through resets, policy execution, and wrapper adaptation.

Profiles compare by ordered contents and address terms by existing manager-visible names, including observation groups and event modes. Validate every selection before atomically publishing one generation across action, command, event, observation, reward, curriculum, metrics, and recorder managers. Report every rejecting address and preserve the preceding generation. Unavailable event model fields invalidate transitions before any manager changes generation. One invalid grouped term rejects a multi-manager request and preserves all preceding selections.

Publish accepted generations only between complete policy steps, never within a decimation loop. A mixed profile requested during a step takes effect on the next step and suppresses action writes without changing observation shapes. Disabled terms stop effects and state advancement while retaining visible shapes, held values, schedules, aggregates, configured scaling, reduction semantics, and lifecycle order for faithful resumption.
